related.title: Ceph：副本位置與相關失效域枚舉
related.titleEn: Ceph: replica placement and correlated failure-domain enumeration
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付restore-dag.json、earliest-times.csv、verification-fixture.json及acceptance.md；接手者可由邊與時間重算11分鐘。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver restore-dag.json, earliest-times.csv, verification-fixture.json and acceptance.md. The receiving operator must recompute the eleven-minute completion from dependencies and durations, not from a prewritten total.
related.difference: 建立OSD到機架的映射，逐一枚舉機架故障時存活副本；區分至少一份可讀與符合指定服務策略的最低存活份數。
related.differenceEn: Map OSDs to racks and enumerate surviving replicas for each rack outage. Distinguish retaining at least one readable copy from satisfying the exercise service policy for minimum surviving copies.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Velero還原有資源次序與外掛相關行為；本課工作時間及平行性是合成計畫，並不宣稱Velero會依此自動排程或保證應用一致性。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 namespace2分鐘與CRD3分鐘可同時開始；volume4分鐘在namespace後；workload2分鐘需CRD與volume完成；驗證3分鐘在workload後。 volume於6分鐘完成，workload於8，驗證於11；串列相加14分鐘會忽略允許平行，只有8分鐘則漏掉應用驗證。

Ceph透過placement groups及放置規則配置資料；本課用明確機架清單與最低兩份的教學服務門檻，不將其當成任何叢集預設。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 A副本在R1,R2,R3，B在R1,R1,R2；三機架各輪流單獨故障一次，教學門檻為至少兩份存活。 A各次皆存活2份，通過3/3=100%；B失R1僅剩1，失R2剩2，失R3剩3，通過2/3=66.666667%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Velero restoration has resource ordering and plugin-dependent behavior. Durations and parallelism below define a synthetic plan, not a claim that Velero automatically uses this schedule or guarantees application consistency. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Namespace takes two minutes and CRD three, starting in parallel. Volume takes four after namespace; workload takes two after both CRD and volume; verification takes three after workload. Volume finishes at minute six, workload at eight and verification at eleven. Summing every duration serially gives fourteen and ignores permitted parallelism; stopping at eight omits application verification.

Ceph uses placement groups and placement rules to place data. This fixture uses explicit rack locations and a two-copy teaching service threshold, not an assertion about any cluster default configuration. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. A replicas are on R1,R2,R3; B replicas are on R1,R1,R2. Fail each of the three racks separately, requiring at least two surviving copies under the exercise policy. A retains two copies in every case and passes 3/3=100%. B retains one after R1 loss, two after R2 loss and three after R3 loss, passing 2/3=66.666667%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: CISA CTEP：分支情境矩陣與未演練決策路徑
related.titleEn: CISA CTEP: scenario-branch matrices and unexercised decision paths
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付restore-dag.json、earliest-times.csv、verification-fixture.json及acceptance.md；接手者可由邊與時間重算11分鐘。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver restore-dag.json, earliest-times.csv, verification-fixture.json and acceptance.md. The receiving operator must recompute the eleven-minute completion from dependencies and durations, not from a prewritten total.
related.difference: 將證據可用、主要聯絡角色可用、備份驗證通過三個二元因素列出全部組合，為每組寫預期決策、停止條件與觀察證據。
related.differenceEn: Enumerate all combinations of three binary factors: evidence availability, primary-contact availability and backup-verification success. Define expected decisions, stop conditions and observable evidence for each combination.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

CISA CTEP提供可調整的目標、情境與討論材料；本課8格矩陣是自行設計的覆蓋模型，不代表CISA認證或完整風險集合。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 三個二元因素共2×2×2=8格；第一輪有4個不同組合留下決策證據，另重複其中一格3次，不算新增覆蓋。 不同組合覆蓋4/8=50%，不是7/8；重複次數可測熟練或一致性，但不等於探索新決策路徑。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Velero restoration has resource ordering and plugin-dependent behavior. Durations and parallelism below define a synthetic plan, not a claim that Velero automatically uses this schedule or guarantees application consistency. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Namespace takes two minutes and CRD three, starting in parallel. Volume takes four after namespace; workload takes two after both CRD and volume; verification takes three after workload. Volume finishes at minute six, workload at eight and verification at eleven. Summing every duration serially gives fourteen and ignores permitted parallelism; stopping at eight omits application verification.

CISA CTEP provides customizable objectives, scenarios and discussion materials. The eight-cell matrix is an original coverage model, not a CISA certification or an exhaustive inventory of operational risks. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Three binary factors produce 2×2×2=8 cells. The first round documents decisions for four distinct combinations; three additional repeats of one existing combination add no new branch coverage. Distinct-combination coverage is 4/8=50%, not 7/8. Repetition can assess consistency or practice, but it does not explore a previously untested decision branch.
